sameAs.description: Source column name to clone, or a trailing '*' wildcard to select multiple columns. Must match the name of a column defined in this object's "columns" array.

exclude.description: Column names to omit when 'sameAs' ends with '*'; only valid with wildcard expansion. Must match the name of a column defined in this object's "columns" array.

name.description: Optional output column name override; not allowed with wildcard expansion.

description.description: Optional description override; not allowed with wildcard expansion. Defaults from the source column.

name.description: The name of the cloned object; combined with the source object's name unless 'fullName' is true.

fullName.description: Whether 'name' is used verbatim as the cloned object's name instead of being prefixed with the source object's name.

referenceUrl.description: Optional URL substituted into '?{}' placeholders found in this clone's description.

description.description: Description for the cloned object; '?{}' is substituted with the source object's original description.

referenceTag.description: Optional label used alongside 'referenceUrl' when rewriting this clone's description.

srcObject.description: The object to clone columns from. Must match the name of an object defined in this schema or one of its dependencies.

srcColumns.description: Column-cloning rules; defaults to cloning all columns ('*') if omitted.

type.description: The type, e.g. STRING(50), INTEGER, DATETIME; append '[]' for an ordered list or '{}' for an unordered set, e.g. INTEGER[].

size.description: Size/length, mainly used for sized types such as STRING(n) when not expressed inline in 'type'.

scale.description: Scale for NUMERIC types (default: 4); must not exceed 'precision'.

name.description: The name of the column, unique within its object (case-insensitive).

sameAs.description: Derives this column from another column (optionally qualified as 'package.schema.object.column'), inheriting its type/size unless overridden. Must resolve to a column, optionally qualified as "package.schema.object.column" (each segment defaulting to the current one); may also resolve to a view column where applicable.

nullable.description: Whether this column allows NULL values.

allowEmpty.description: Whether an empty string is allowed; only valid for non-nullable STRING columns.

invariant.description: Whether this column's value cannot change after row creation.

mode.description: Column mode, e.g. NORMAL or CALCULATED (see ColumnMode).

protect.description: De-identification/protection strategy applied to this STRING column (see ProtectionType).

tzMode.description: Timezone handling mode for this DATETIME column (see TZMode); falls back to the parent object's/schema's convention if unset.

default.description: Default value expression applied on row creation/update.

description.description: Description of this column; mandatory unless inherited from a 'sameAs' reference.

mapper.description: Maps this column's values to/from an external mapping table; mutually exclusive with 'enum'.

enum.description: Restricts/labels this column's values using an enumeration; mutually exclusive with 'mapper'.

values.description: Named, well-known values for this column (e.g., documented constants and/or defaults).

jsonSchema.description: The JSON structure definition for this column; only valid when 'type' is JSON.

name.description: The identifier for this value (used as the generated constant name).

value.description: The actual stored value; defaults to 'name' if omitted.

label.description: Human-friendly label for this value; defaults to 'name' if omitted.

description.description: Description of this value; defaults to 'label' if omitted.

groupings.description: Optional group tags used to categorize this value.

default.description: Whether/when this value is used as the column's default, e.g. CREATE or ALWAYS (see DefaultType).

sameAs.description: Reuses another schema's conventions wholesale; when set, no other convention fields (except 'default*' ones) may be defined. Must resolve to another already-loaded Tilda schema, referenced as "package.schemaName".

primaryKeyName.description: Name used for auto-generated primary key columns (default: 'refnum').

createdName.description: Name used for the OCC 'created' timestamp column (default: 'created').

lastUpdatedName.description: Name used for the OCC 'lastUpdated' timestamp column (default: 'lastUpdated').

deletedName.description: Name used for the OCC 'deleted' timestamp column (default: 'deleted').

foreignKeyNamePostfix.description: Postfix appended to generated foreign key names.

columnNamingConvention.description: Naming convention enforced for column names (see ConventionNaming).

caseSensitiveColumns.description: Whether column names are treated as case-sensitive.

defaultMode.description: Default 'mode' applied to objects/views that don't declare one explicitly.

defaultLC.description: Default lifecycle applied to objects that don't declare one explicitly.

defaultTzMode.description: Default timezone mode applied to objects/columns that don't declare one explicitly.

tzRowName.description: Name used for the row-level timezone column (default: 'rowTZ').

before.description: Paths to SQL script resources executed before this schema's generated DDL.

after.description: Paths to SQL script resources executed after this schema's generated DDL.

name.description: The name of this foreign key, used to derive its generated constraint/identifier name.

srcColumns.description: The columns of the declaring object making up this foreign key; must line up, in order and count, with the destination object's primary key columns. Must match the name of a column defined in this object's "columns" array.

destObject.description: The object this foreign key points to. Must match the name of an object defined in this schema or one of its dependencies.

type.description: The type, e.g. STRING(50), INTEGER, DATETIME; append '[]' for an ordered list or '{}' for an unordered set, e.g. INTEGER[].

size.description: Size/length, mainly used for sized types such as STRING(n) when not expressed inline in 'type'.

scale.description: Scale for NUMERIC types (default: 4); must not exceed 'precision'.

measure.description: Whether this formula represents a measure.

formula.description: SQL formula expression, optionally specified as one clause per supported database.

title.description: Short title for this formula, used in generated documentation and metadata.

id.description: Optional stable identifier for this formula.

description.description: One or more lines describing this formula.

values.description: Enumerated result values and their descriptions when the formula has a finite set of known results.

coalesceNumbers.description: Whether numeric inputs are coalesced when evaluating the formula (default: true).

impls.description: Implementation objects defining the template's expansion behavior; at least one is required.

postfix.description: Suffix appended to the source object name to form its history object name (default: '_Hist').

includedColumns.description: Column names or wildcard patterns included in history rows (default: all columns). Must match the name of a column defined in this object's "columns" array.

excludedColumns.description: Column names excluded from history rows; OCC lifecycle columns are excluded automatically. Must match the name of a column defined in this object's "columns" array.

signatureColumns.description: Column names or wildcard patterns used to detect meaningful row changes (default: all columns). Must match the name of a column defined in this object's "columns" array.

signatureColumnsExclude.description: Column names excluded from the history signature; primary key and OCC timestamps are excluded automatically. Must match the name of a column defined in this object's "columns" array.

compressionSeconds.description: History compression window in seconds; zero disables compression.

name.description: The name of this index, used to derive its generated identifier.

columns.description: Column names making up this index, optionally followed by a modifier, e.g. 'colName lal' or 'colName(mod=val;)'. Must match the name of a column defined in this object's "columns" array.

cluster.description: Whether the database should cluster the table's physical storage on this index.

orderBy.description: Column names (optionally suffixed with 'asc'/'desc') this index sorts by; presence makes the index non-unique. Must match the name of a column defined in this object's "columns" array.

db.description: Whether this index is actually created in the database (vs. only tracked/documented).

nullsNotDistinct.description: Whether NULLs are treated as equal (not distinct) for uniqueness purposes.

subQuery.description: Structured, per-database partial-index WHERE clause (preferred over 'subWhere').

type.description: The type, e.g. STRING(50), INTEGER, DATETIME; append '[]' for an ordered list or '{}' for an unordered set, e.g. INTEGER[].

size.description: Size/length, mainly used for sized types such as STRING(n) when not expressed inline in 'type'.

scale.description: Scale for NUMERIC types (default: 4); must not exceed 'precision'.

name.description: The name of this field within its parent JSON structure.

nullable.description: Whether this field may be null/omitted (default: true).

jsonSchema.description: Nested JSON structure definition when this field's value is itself a JSON object (or array of objects).

typeName.description: The generated nested Java class name for this JSON structure.

descr.description: Alternate/legacy form of 'description'; only one of the two may be specified.

description.description: Description of this JSON structure; mutually exclusive with 'descr'.

fields.description: The fields making up this JSON structure.

validation.description: Optional custom validation rule for instances of this JSON structure.

renames.description: Object/column rename operations to apply during migration.

moves.description: Object move operations (between schemas) to apply during migration.

notNulls.description: Column not-null transition operations to apply during migration.

conversions.description: Column type conversion operations to apply during migration.

object.description: Object containing the column to convert. Must match the name of an object defined in this schema or one of its dependencies.

column.description: Column whose stored values are transformed. Must match the name of a column defined in this object's "columns" array.

conversion.description: SQL expression used to convert the selected column's values.

schema.description: Destination schema name for the selected objects and views. Must resolve to another already-loaded Tilda schema, referenced as "package.schemaName".

objects.description: Objects to move into the destination schema; entries may also identify objects being renamed in the same migration. Must match the name of an object defined in this schema or one of its dependencies.

views.description: Views to move into the destination schema; entries may also identify views being renamed in the same migration. Must match the name of a view defined in this schema or one of its dependencies.

object.description: Object containing the columns being made non-null. Must match the name of an object defined in this schema or one of its dependencies.

columns.description: One or more columns to make non-null; all columns must have compatible types and no existing create default. Must match the name of a column defined in this object's "columns" array.

default.description: Required value to backfill existing rows before applying the not-null constraint.

object.description: Object whose name or column name is being renamed; mutually exclusive with 'view'. Must match the name of an object defined in this schema or one of its dependencies.

view.description: View whose name is being renamed; mutually exclusive with 'object'. Must match the name of a view defined in this schema or one of its dependencies.

column.description: Column to rename within the specified object; not valid when renaming a view. Must match the name of a column defined in this object's "columns" array.

oldNames.description: One or more previous names for the selected object, view, or column.

name.description: The name of this object/view. Must be a unique, valid SQL/Java identifier within its schema.

mode.description: Object/view mode, e.g. NORMAL, DB_ONLY or CODE_ONLY (see ObjectMode); falls back to the schema's convention if unset.

prefix.description: Optional short alias/prefix used when generating SQL/Java identifiers for this object/view (e.g. index names).

description.description: Human-readable description of this object/view. Mutually exclusive with 'descriptionX'; exactly one of the two is mandatory.

descriptionX.description: Multi-line alternative to 'description': an array of strings joined with spaces. Mutually exclusive with 'description'; exactly one of the two is mandatory.

referenceUrl.description: Optional URL substituted into '?{}' placeholders found in this object/view's description (and its columns' descriptions).

referenceTag.description: Optional label used alongside 'referenceUrl' when rewriting descriptions.

entityClass.description: Must match one of the schema's declared 'entityClasses' names; mandatory if the schema defines any entityClasses, forbidden otherwise.

queries.description: Named sub-where query definitions available for this object/view.

outputMaps.description: Named output column-set mappings (e.g., CSV/JSON exports) for this object/view.

masks.description: De-identification/masking rules applied to specific columns of this object/view.

tenantInit.description: Whether this object/view participates in per-tenant initialization.

occ.description: Whether this object uses Optimistic Concurrency Control, adding the framework's created/lastUpdated/deleted columns.

tzFk.description: Whether foreign keys pointing to this object also carry along its row-level timezone column.

tzMode.description: Default timezone handling mode (see TZMode) applied to this object's DATETIME columns; falls back to the schema's convention if unset.

etl.description: Whether this object also generates ETL-specific created/lastUpdated columns.

lc.description: Object lifecycle, e.g. NORMAL or WORM (write-once-read-many); see ObjectLifecycle.

cloneFrom.description: Clones this object's columns from another source object.

cloneAs.description: Declares one or more clones of this object under different (derived) names.

columns.description: The columns making up this object.

primary.description: The primary key definition for this object.

foreign.description: Foreign key definitions for this object.

http.description: HTTP endpoint mappings generated for this object.

history.description: Bi-temporal history/versioning configuration for this object.

columns.description: Column names making up the primary key; mutually exclusive with 'autogen'. Must match the name of a column defined in this object's "columns" array.

autogen.description: Whether to auto-generate a single-column primary key (using the schema's naming convention) instead of listing 'columns'.

keyBatch.description: Batch size for pre-allocating auto-generated primary key values; only valid when 'autogen' is true.

sequence.description: Whether the auto-generated primary key is backed by a database sequence instead of Tilda's key-allocation table; only valid when 'autogen' is true.

db.description: Database type this clause applies to; '*' applies to all supported databases.

clause.description: SQL clause used by this query, with TILDA parameter/column syntax.

name.description: Name of this reusable query/sub-where definition; required when declared at object/view level.

description.description: Description of this reusable query; required when declared at object/view level.

from.description: Objects participating in the query's FROM clause; references are resolved in the current schema/dependency context. Must match the name of an object defined in this schema or one of its dependencies.

wheres.description: Database-specific query clauses; at least one query is required.

orderBy.description: Column expressions controlling result ordering. Must resolve to a column, optionally qualified as "package.schema.object.column" (each segment defaulting to the current one); may also resolve to a view column where applicable.

type.description: The type, e.g. STRING(50), INTEGER, DATETIME; append '[]' for an ordered list or '{}' for an unordered set, e.g. INTEGER[].

description.description: Description of the formula result value.

prefix.description: Optional short alias/prefix used when generating SQL/Java identifiers for this object/view (e.g. index names).

description.description: Human-readable description of this object/view. Mutually exclusive with 'descriptionX'; exactly one of the two is mandatory.

descriptionX.description: Multi-line alternative to 'description': an array of strings joined with spaces. Mutually exclusive with 'description'; exactly one of the two is mandatory.

referenceUrl.description: Optional URL substituted into '?{}' placeholders found in this object/view's description (and its columns' descriptions).

outputMaps.description: Named output column-set mappings (e.g., CSV/JSON exports) for this object/view.

masks.description: De-identification/masking rules applied to specific columns of this object/view.

tenantInit.description: Whether this object/view participates in per-tenant initialization.

columns.description: The columns making up this view.

joins.description: Object joins used to compute this view's rows.

subWhere.description: Legacy free-form SQL WHERE clause applied to this view; prefer 'subWhereX'.

subWhereX.description: Structured, per-database WHERE clause applied to this view (preferred over 'subWhere').

subQuery.description: Named reusable sub-query definition associated with this view.

pivot.description: Single declarative pivot transformation for this view (see also 'pivots').

pivots.description: One or more declarative pivot transformations for this view.

timeSeries.description: Time-series bucketing/aggregation configuration for this view.

distinctOn.description: DISTINCT ON configuration for this view.

realize.description: Configuration to materialize (realize) this view into a physical table.

importFormulas.description: Names of other views whose 'formulaColumns' should be imported into this view. Must match the name of a view defined in this schema or one of its dependencies.

formulaColumns.description: Computed/derived formula columns defined on this view.

formulaTemplates.description: Reusable formula templates available to this view's formula columns.

as.description: Optional alias overriding the default output name for this view column.

expression.description: SQL expression defining this view column when it isn't a simple 'sameAs' passthrough.
